# Harness audit and improvements  Reviewed on 2026-09-13 from commit `5e0346c06c57df7bc30a156643364c797c2aeee4`. The checkout was clean before implementation. This is a TypeScript/Node application with a custom localhost HTTP/SSE UI, an ANSI terminal UI, filesystem tools and local model integrations. It is not a Next.js application. Public-site SEO, accounts, payments and database checks do not apply.
## Confirmed issues addressed  | Problem | Consequence | Change |
## Interaction changes  The web UI removes the ASCII welcome banner, explanatory subtitle, repeated workspace paths, duplicate model labels and permanent keyboard-help row. It uses normal text for navigation and prose, monospace for code, expandable tool activity, one updating plan per turn, and compact model/mode/effort/context controls. Detailed output remains available on demand; errors expand automatically. Mobile panels occupy the available width.
## Runtime design  Background compaction is opportunistic. At 60% input-budget pressure, a running command creates an opportunity to summarize a frozen transcript with the same model. The summary has no tools, thinking disabled, at most 700 output tokens and a 45-second deadline. Foreground work cancels unfinished maintenance. A prepared result is applied only if its source prefix still matches, it shrinks the prompt sufficiently, and the unsummarized suffix remains intact.
